changesRequestedReviews.body: The overall design needs to be reconsidered. Please see my comments in the review summary above.

instructions: Review each item under `## Changes-requested reviews` and decide whether it needs a code change.
If you will push, first cancel every ID under `## In-progress runs` with `gh run cancel <id>` (ignore errors for runs that already finished). If you will not push, leave them alone.
Read every body under `## Changes-requested reviews` and apply any warranted change.
If you changed code, commit any remaining changes and push. Otherwise, do not commit or push.

For any substantial decision or rejection, append `- <decision>` to Shepherd Journal with `pr-shepherd apply journal 42 '- <decision>'`. See "Shepherd Journal" in the pr-shepherd skill for citation conventions.
`[FIX_CODE]` is non-terminal. After completing these steps, iterate again to continue.
